items.title: File Einspruch against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb von zwei Wochen ab seiner Zustellung Einspruch einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Stadt Musterquellen – Bußgeldstelle.
items.computation: This is a formally served (zugestellt per Postzustellungsurkunde) Bußgeldbescheid, so the delivery day is the date written on the envelope by the postal carrier, not a fixed-days-after-posting fiction. The attached envelope scan shows the handwritten delivery date '21.11.2026' (zugestellt), which is a Saturday. Under §§ 187, 188 BGB the day of delivery itself is not counted; the two-week period under § 67 OWiG / § 43 StPO therefore runs from Sunday 22.11.2026 and ends two weeks later on the same weekday as the delivery day, i.e. Saturday 05.12.2026. Since the last day falls on a Saturday, § 43 Abs. 2 StPO (together with § 193 BGB) moves the end to the next working day. No public holiday intervenes in NW between 05.12.2026 and the next working day, so the period ends on Monday 07.12.2026.

items.title: Pay the fine (Gesamtbetrag) once the notice becomes final
items.quote: Zahlen Sie erst, wenn dieser Bescheid rechtskräftig geworden ist, und dann binnen zwei Wochen auf das Konto DE29 5135 0025 0002 1403 00.
items.computation: Payment is explicitly conditional: it is only due once the Bußgeldbescheid becomes rechtskräftig (final), i.e. once the Einspruch period has expired without an objection having been filed. The Einspruch period ends Monday 07.12.2026 (see other item); assuming no Einspruch is lodged, the notice becomes final the following day, Tuesday 08.12.2026. From that day, the stated two-week payment period runs under §§ 187, 188, 193 BGB: the start day (08.12.2026) is not counted, and the period ends two weeks later on the same weekday, i.e. Tuesday 22.12.2026, which is not a weekend day or public holiday in NW, so no further adjustment is needed. This date is contingent on no Einspruch being filed; if an Einspruch is filed, this payment obligation does not (yet) arise.

warnings: The payment due date (2026-12-22) assumes no Einspruch is filed within the two-week deadline (2026-12-07); if an Einspruch is lodged, the notice does not become final and no payment is yet due.

The sender's email address ('bussgeld@stadt-musterquellen-bußgelds.example') has an unusual domain format (containing 'ß' and an added 's'); verify this is the genuine official contact before replying or sending any information.

The letter instructs payment to IBAN DE29 5135 0025 0002 1403 00 at 'Landesmusterbank' — verify this IBAN independently (e.g. via the city's official website) before paying, as fine notices are a known target for payment-redirection scams.
